findings.claim: CliRunner.invoke flushes sys.stdout in its finally block after the command has run, and echo_via_pager obtains a pager file via get_pager_file which is used as a context manager around the write.
findings.explanation: The traceback points to click/testing.py:676 sys.stdout.flush() in the finally section of CliRunner.invoke. The finally block flushes sys.stdout and sys.stderr after executing the CLI, then stops FD capture. echo_via_pager in src/click/termui.py opens a pager via `with get_pager_file(color=color) as pager:` and writes to it. The get_pager_file implementation yields a stream and flushes it in its finally clause, so the pager stream – which under the test runner can be tied to the captured stdout – is closed/flushed before the invoke finally attempts sys.stdout.flush(), leading to the ValueError: I/O operation on closed file observed with Click 8.4.
